para_examples.original: Our focus is on delivering value at sustainable price levels, and we plan to keep our pricing steady and premium in this market. We'd encourage everyone in the category to compete on quality rather than discounts.
para_examples.delivered: Our priority is providing real value at prices that can be sustained over time, and we intend to keep our pricing consistent and at a premium level in this market. We'd urge everyone in the category to compete on quality instead of discount

para_examples.original: I'm planning to hold a premium price this season and focus on delivering value rather than chasing volume. A stable, healthy market works better for everyone.
para_examples.delivered: This season I intend to maintain premium pricing and concentrate on delivering real value rather than pursuing sheer volume. A steady, sound market serves everyone best.

para_examples.original: Our strategy remains steady, premium pricing built on quality, and we're moving our price up to reflect the value we deliver. We'd expect a healthy, stable market to benefit everyone who stays disciplined.
para_examples.delivered: Our approach stays consistent: we charge premium prices grounded in the quality we provide, and we're raising our price to match the value we deliver. We anticipate that a sound, stable market will serve everyone who remains disciplined.

para_examples.original: I'm sticking with a premium position and don't plan to chase volume with discounts; a steady, healthy price level serves the whole category best. I'll keep my price at a level that reflects the value we deliver.
para_examples.delivered: I'm holding a premium position and have no intention of competing on volume through discounts; a stable, healthy price level is what best serves the entire category. I will keep my pricing at a level that reflects the value we provide.
